issues.reason: The text says only that the figure was compared WITH a year-earlier profit — a comparison contrasts, so "that" may well be a loss; typing it profit asserts more than the text states, and the no-antecedent pronoun rule gives thing when no kind is text-supplied.

Both magnitudes are true of that profit and the rate unit follows the licensed compound-unit convention (kilometer_per_hour); that the restatement relation is unrecorded is the coverage gap the reviewer registers, and improvisation in gap territory with true, well-typed atoms is acceptable per the calibration line.

Measures & units fixes the scale as "the surface dimension … else the dimension noun" and tells the parser to record what is said; "a profit of $102 million" supplies no other dimension word, so profit is the faithful scale and the atom is neither false nor ill-typed.

gaps_confirmed: appositional / reformulating "or" ("$102 million, or 13 cents a share") — Disjunction has only inclusive Or and Xor, no equative/restatement sense
a per-share (rate-denominated) restatement of a total — no way to mark two magnitudes as one value on two denominators
a temporal modifier on an entity noun ("a year-earlier profit") — Time attaches to eventualities, so the anteriority survives only inside the fused compound symbol
a discourse-deictic "That" pointing at an unsupplied preceding sentence — the pointing itself has no licensed record (the no-antecedent fallback gives only an untethered witness)
new_gaps: a measure whose dimension noun IS the measured entity's own kind ("a profit of $102 million") — the scale slot collapses onto the kind symbol, so (Measure sk_profit_2 profit …) reads self-referentially with no licensed alternative
repair_summary: Retyped the antecedentless "That" as the licensed fallback witness — (Member sk_thing_1 thing) in place of (Member sk_profit_1 profit) — minting the symbol from the class as the rule requires, and updated the one reference to it in cmp_exp.
notes: The prepositional-verb oblique (With …) for "compared with", the Experiencer subject, and the year_earlier_profit genus were not challenged and stand.
